name: Continuous Marching Dashed Flow
visual_intent: Shows reverse error flow through weight matrices or feedback loops without abrupt visual snapping.

parameters.name: containerSelector
parameters.description: Group element wrapping backprop vector connections.

parameters.name: lineSelector
parameters.description: SVG line or path elements with stroke-dasharray styling.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Timestamp in seconds to begin backprop flow.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Total duration of active marching flow.

parameters.name: dashOffsetShift
parameters.description: Pixel distance to shift stroke-dashoffset (negative for backward flow).

timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: Spans the mathematical voice explanation of loss computation and chain rule.

code_snippet.html:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
  <g id="backprop-arrows" opacity="0">
    <line x1="600" y1="300" x2="200" y2="300" stroke="#f85149" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/>
  </g>
</svg>

fallbacks: Static dashed stroke with opacity blink if continuous dashoffset is not supported.
validation_steps: Snapshot at startTime + 0.5s and startTime + 2.0s to confirm strokeDashoffset progression.
Confirm no visual hitching or frame drop during continuous linear tween.
